tools.name: ns1_list_zones
tools.description: List the DNS zones in the account: name, id, TTL/SOA settings, primary/secondary setup, linked zones and tags. If next_page is not null, call again with its after/offset to get more. GET /v1/zones.

tools.name: ns1_get_zone
tools.description: One zone with its settings and its record list (each record: domain, type, TTL, short answers, linked/tier info). Large zones are paged: if next_page is not null, call again with its after/offset to get the next records. TSIG secrets are redacted. GET /v1/zones/{zone}.

tools.name: ns1_get_record
tools.description: One DNS record by zone, domain and type: TTL, answers (with per-answer metadata), filter chain (traffic steering), linked record and region settings. GET /v1/zones/{zone}/{domain}/{type}.

tools.name: ns1_search
tools.description: Search the account's zones and records by name (substring match). Returns matching zones and/or records with their answers when expand is true. GET /v1/search.

tools.name: ns1_list_monitoring_jobs
tools.description: List the account's NS1 monitoring jobs (health checks that feed traffic steering): id, name, type, regions, frequency, rules, current status, active flag and notify list id. Request header values and credentials are redacted. GET /v1/monitoring/jobs.

tools.name: ns1_get_monitoring_job
tools.description: One monitoring job by id with its configuration, rules, regions and status. Header values and credentials are redacted. GET /v1/monitoring/jobs/{id}.

tools.name: ns1_list_notify_lists
tools.description: List the notifier lists that monitoring alerts are sent to: id, name and the notifier types and labels (email, Slack, PagerDuty, webhook). Notifier settings (webhook URLs, tokens, service keys, addresses) are redacted. GET /v1/lists.

tools.name: ns1_list_data_sources
tools.description: List the data sources (connections to third-party monitoring or custom push sources used for traffic steering): id, name, source type, status and their feeds. Connection settings and credentials are redacted. GET /v1/data/sources.

tools.name: ns1_get_data_source
tools.description: One data source by id with its feeds. Connection settings and credentials are redacted. GET /v1/data/sources/{id}.

tools.name: ns1_list_data_feeds
tools.description: List the feeds of one data source (each feed is one monitored item, e.g. one server's health) with id, name and settings. GET /v1/data/feeds/{source_id}.

tools.name: ns1_get_data_feed
tools.description: One data feed of a source by id. GET /v1/data/feeds/{source_id}/{feed_id}.

tools.name: ns1_get_account_summary
tools.description: The account's subscription, resources and utilization (queries, records, filter chains, monitors, ... against the plan limits). GET /v1/account/summary.

tools.name: ns1_get_usage_stats
tools.description: DNS query counts for the whole account, one zone, or one record (give zone, or zone + domain + type). period is 1h, 24h or 30d; aggregate, expand, limit and after apply to the account and zone levels only (a record takes just period). If next_page is not null, call again with its after/limit. GET /v

tools.name: ns1_get_qps_stats
tools.description: Current queries per second for the whole account, one zone, or one record (give zone, or zone + domain + type). GET /v1/stats/qps[/{zone}[/{domain}/{type}]].

tools.name: ns1_get_billing_records
tools.description: How many DNS records the account uses against its plan limit in the current billing cycle. GET /billing-usage/v1/records.

tools.name: ns1_get_billing_queries
tools.description: Billable DNS query usage between two Unix timestamps. GET /billing-usage/v1/queries?from=&to=.

tools.name: ns1_create_record
tools.description: WRITE: creates ONE new DNS record and CHANGES LIVE DNS for that name as soon as NS1 serves it; a wrong answer can take a site or mail offline. Plain records only (A, AAAA, ALIAS, CAA, CNAME, MX, PTR, SRV, TXT; no NS/SOA, no traffic-steering filters or metadata). Refuses when the record already exist

tools.name: ns1_update_record
tools.description: WRITE: changes ONE existing DNS record and CHANGES LIVE DNS for that name immediately. Giving answers REPLACES all current answers of the record (send the complete new set); giving only ttl changes just the TTL. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ns1_list_monitoring_jobs, ns1_list_notify_lists, ns1_list_data_sources, ns1_get_data_source, ns1_list_data_feeds, ns1_get_data_feed · Private data: ns1_get_zone, ns1_get_record, ns1_search, ns1_list_monitoring_jobs, ns1_get_monitoring_job, ns1_list_notify_lists, ns1_list_data_sources, ns1_get_data_source, ns1_get_account_summary, ns1_get_usage_stats, ns1_get_qps_stats, ns1_get_billing_records, ns1_create_record, ns1_update_record · Public sink: ns1_list_monitoring_jobs, ns1_list_notify_lists, ns1_update_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ns1_list_monitoring_jobs, ns1_list_notify_lists, ns1_list_data_sources, ns1_get_data_source, ns1_list_data_feeds, ns1_get_data_feed · Private data: ns1_get_zone, ns1_get_record, ns1_search, ns1_list_monitoring_jobs, ns1_get_monitoring_job, ns1_list_notify_lists, ns1_list_data_sources, ns1_get_data_source, ns1_get_account_summary, ns1_get_usage_stats, ns1_get_qps_stats, ns1_get_billing_records, ns1_create_record, ns1_update_record · Public sink: ns1_list_monitoring_jobs, ns1_list_notify_lists, ns1_update_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
